ground_truth.root_cause: The 5x5 array pitch is 15.002 um, which is 2 nm off the 5 nm manufacturing grid. Every off-grid instance puts its Metal1 edges off grid. The cell itself is clean.

fix.action: snap the array pitch to the grid (15.0 um)

notes: One root cause, 480 markers. Control run at 15.0 um pitch is DRC clean. Marker count measured, not derived.
